disclaimer: Generated inspection protocol: it lists what a technician must physically check. It does not verify the product; results come only from the physical inspection and its evidence.

inspectionScope.rule: Count all 50 units. Checks marked "sample" are done in full on 10 randomly chosen units (max of 10 or 10%), with every other unit given a quick visual screen; any failure in the sample widens the check to the whole lot.

parameters.title: Unit Count
parameters.description: Count every unit in the lot.
instructions: Count every unit individually
Compare with the listed quantity
Record any shortfall
parameters.expectedResult: Counted quantity equals the listed quantity. Declared: 50.
parameters.verificationInstruction: Count every unit and compare with the claim.
parameters.reason: Conditional check: isLot = true (from quantity (50)). Provider claim: Quantity = 50, declared by the provider.

parameters.title: Structural Integrity
parameters.description: Check load-bearing parts are sound and the item is stable in use.
instructions: Check legs, frames and joints for cracks, looseness or repairs
Place on a level floor and check for wobble
Apply moderate hand pressure as a user would; do not stand on or overload the item
Sit-test sampled chairs gently; check the seat frame and back spindles for movement
parameters.expectedResult: No cracks or loose joints; stable under normal load.
parameters.reason: Category baseline for furniture (furniture template). Product-specific (banquet_chairs): Banquet chairs are hired in lots, stacked for transport, and handled most at the backrest and legs.

parameters.title: Wood Joints, Grain & Splits
parameters.description: Check wooden parts for splits, loose rungs and failed glue joints.
instructions: Check every joint and rung for movement
Look along the grain for splits and cracks
Check for woodworm holes
parameters.expectedResult: Joints tight; no splits or woodworm.
parameters.reason: Conditional check: material = wood (claim: Material = Wooden).

parameters.title: Folding / Stacking Mechanism
parameters.description: Check folding or stacking works and locks.
instructions: Fold and unfold, or stack and unstack, several units
Check locks engage and there are no pinch hazards from bent parts
parameters.expectedResult: Folds or stacks smoothly; locks engage.

parameters.title: Material
parameters.description: Confirm the item is made of the material declared.
instructions: Inspect exposed surfaces, underside and edges
Compare with the declared material
parameters.expectedResult: Material matches the declaration. Declared: Wooden.
parameters.verificationInstruction: Inspect exposed surfaces and compare the material with the claim.
parameters.reason: Provider claim: Material = Wooden, declared by the provider.

parameters.title: Surface & Finish
parameters.description: Check paint, polish, lacquer or plating.
instructions: Check for chips, scratches, peeling or flaking finish
Check the finish is consistent across the lot
Check the backrest top and legs closely — the most handled areas — for chipped paint or plating
parameters.reason: Category baseline for furniture (furniture template). Product-specific (banquet_chairs): Banquet chairs are hired in lots, stacked for transport, and handled most at the backrest and legs.

parameters.title: Cleanliness & Hygiene
parameters.description: Check the item is clean and fit to hand to a customer.
instructions: Check for dirt, residue, odour and pests
Check food-contact or skin-contact surfaces closely
parameters.expectedResult: Clean, odour-free and ready for use.

parameters.title: Declared Condition Grade
parameters.description: Compare the item's overall state with the condition the provider declared.
instructions: Read the declared condition grade
Decide whether the observed state matches, exceeds or falls short of it
Record the grade you would assign
parameters.expectedResult: Observed condition matches the declared grade.
parameters.verificationInstruction: Grade the observed condition and compare it with the declared grade.
parameters.reason: Category baseline for furniture (furniture template). Provider declared condition: Good.
